chapter_title: Also concerning the Catechumen; shall he be saved
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶8:**
When, however, spirits are released from their outermost natural state, they advance through successive spiritual states, passing through the interior degrees above the merely sensuous plane, and enter into life itself — which is life from the Divine. They undergo purification in heavenly states of good and truth, and they are gathered in just as a completed good work, having reached its fullness of ripening, is gathered from the living perception that bore it. For as a tree is the mind's power of perception, and fruit is the good work that perception brings forth, so a soul whose spiritual goods have matured within its understanding of truth is separated and received into eternal life at the moment of completion.

**¶20:**
As for the remainder, the spirit shall be examined concerning even a single particular of his inner state, and shall undergo the painful consequences of his evils and their just requital. Afterward he is purified — whether through interior reformation in higher states or through external vastation in lower ones. He is purified in exact proportion to the quality of his spiritual works: cleansed from evils, washed by the inflowing of truths, and clothed with the external truths that adorn the regenerate mind. Afterward he is formed into a living image of wisdom — his whole being shaped according to Divine light — and he ascends, rising into the state of heavenly peace.

---
*Note on the progression "cleansed and washed and adorned":* This sequence corresponds precisely to the threefold process Swedenborg describes — removal of evil (cleansing), reception of truth (washing, since water = truth), and the investiture of new external truths as garments (adornment). The final "sculpting of a light image" corresponds to the formation of the spiritual body according to wisdom, the complete re-ordering of the human form into correspondence with Divine influx.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: When, however, they come forth from their body, they travel on their way and pass by in the place above, and go in to the life. They shall be purified in the heavens, and they are plucked just as a fruit that ripens is plucked from the tree.

As for the rest, he shall be questioned about a single part; and receive blows for (those sins) and retribution. Afterwards he is purified, whether indeed above or below. He shall be purified according to the worth of his deeds, and cleansed and washed and adorned. Afterwards, he is sculpted a light image; and [he glid]es up and reaches the land of rest,
